item.title: Set up the Blog
item.description:
Today, I would like to share the process of setting up this blog. The three main tools are Hugo, Netlify and Cloudflare.

Framework

Hugo is one of the most popular open-source static site generators. It is an open source project written in Golang. Fast, flexible and free to use are the most important reasons that I chose it. The theme I am using called Stack, and there are alse plenty of other themes to select.

Building a basic blog based on Hugo is pretty easy, the only reference you need is the quick-start tutorial. Using several CLI commands and editing the hugo.toml file, the blog website can start to functioning. And by adding contents to the project, a new blog can be generated. There are many advanced features provided by Hugo or the Stack theme waiting for me to discover. I hope I can dive deeper later and maitain my blog well and make it more interesting.

Deployment

When it comes to deploying a static site, we are lucky to have several world-class platforms. However, for a Hugo-based site (like the one I’m building with the Stack theme), Netlify stands out as the most balanced choice. There are several reasons:

  1. Zero-Config Deployment. The workflow is seamless: I just git push my code to GitHub, and Netlify automatically detects the Hugo framework, builds the site, and deploys it within seconds. No manual uploading is required.
  2. Powerful Built-in Functionalities. Netlify provides easy access to SSL certificate, DNS, Monitoring & Insights, etc. Although some of the functions are not required currently, but it is also good to choose a comprehensive platform.

As I said above, Netlify is very convenient to use. There is a Hugo tutorial about deploying on Netlify. Once you completed the steps, a brand new website would be ready. But the domain is something werid like “illustrious-crisp-79ae99/overview”, so I did the last step to set up my own domain.

Domain

ALthough domain can be purchased and maintained on Netlify, I chose to use Cloudflare for three reasons：

  1. True At-Cost Pricing. The price offerd by Cloudflare is lower. Although other platforms has first-year discount i, I didn’t consider that because I wish to use the domain in my whole life :).
  2. World-Class DNS Performance & Security. Cloudflare runs one of the fastest and largest authoritative DNS networks in the world. Cloudflare provide WHOIS Privacy Protection for free, ensuring your personal contact information isn’t harvested by spammers.
  3. “Separation of Concerns”. In system architecture, it is always a best practice to keep your Assets (Domain) separate from your Services (Hosting).

After purchasing the domain, don’t forget to set it as the custom link for the Netlify project. And also, DNS records need to be added under DNS-Records section on Cloudflare. The type should be “CNAME”, and the content is the original link of Netlify website.

Throughout the process of constructing the blog, I met some problems including .toml file config error, Hugo theme imcompatibiltiy, etc.. I threw the questions to Gemini and high-quality answers showed up right away. All the constructing time I spent on the web so for is less than 1 hour. Not only soving the problems, Gemini also recommend some features or styles for me to try in the future. I have to say, the powerful AI tools should be our best friends. And I hope to post some blogs about AI, too.

Stay tuned.

item.title: Hello World: A New Chapter
item.description:
Finally, sikaizhao.com is live.

This space is more than just a website; it’s a digital garden where I plan to cultivate my thoughts.

My goal is simple: to learn more, to think deeper, and to share frequently. To keep pace with this fast-changing world, constant learning is the only way to ensure we have the power to create better things.

It may be a little bit late for me to start up my personal blog, but as the saying goes: “The best time to plant a tree was 20 years ago. The second best time is now.”

Stay tuned. The journey begins now.
